    ('1.2.3-rc.1+build.01', True),  # build allows leading zeros

for v, expected in tests:
    try:
        semver.parse(v)
        actual = True
    except ValueError:
        actual = False
    status = 'OK' if actual == expected else 'FAIL'
    print(f'{status}: {v!r} -> actual={actual}, expected={expected}')
"
